name: mandi-setu
description: MANDI-SETU — market intelligence and transaction enablement for farmers of Maharashtra. SIH 2026, PS 26132.

scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d postgres && echo 'postgres on :5433'
scripts.db:reset: prisma db push --force-reset && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mandi/contracts && npm run build -w @mandi/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
